Title: CSV Upload
Description: The Dashboard must provide a file uploader to accept broker CSV files.

Title: File Storage
Description: Uploaded CSV files must be saved to the project root directory.

Title: Sequential Parsing
Description: The system must execute 'run_csv_parser.py' followed by 'run_portfolio_history.py' after a successful upload.

Title: File Cleanup
Description: The CSV parser must move processed files to the 'oldcsv' directory (existing functionality confirmed).

Title: Process Feedback
Description: The Dashboard must display the success or failure status of the import process to the user.

Title: Auto Refresh
Description: The Dashboard must verify if data has changed (e.g. journal.csv timestamp) and refresh the view automatically or prompt the user.
